faqs.a: Orders leave our Taroudant workshop within 24–48 hours. Delivery takes 24–48 hours in Casablanca, Rabat and Taroudant, and 2–4 working days everywhere else in Morocco.

faqs.q: Do you deliver all over Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver to all 12 regions, including rural communes, through our courier partners. Free delivery on every order above 500 MAD.

faqs.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faqs.a: Cash on Delivery is our only payment method. You pay the courier in cash when the parcel reaches your hands — nothing upfront, no card details.
You have 14 days from delivery to exchange any unused piece in its original box. Custom-engraved items are excluded because they are made to your initials.
Every piece is full-grain leather, vegetable-tanned in Morocco. No bonded leather, no PU coating. Each item ships with a certificate of origin from the tannery.

faqs.q: How do I care for my leather piece?
faqs.a: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after use and keep it away from prolonged sun and moisture. Apply a neutral leather balm every few months to nourish the hide and let its natural patina deepen.

faqs.q: Can I order a custom piece?
faqs.a: Yes. Send us your initials, measurements and colour preference on WhatsApp and our workshop will confirm the design and price before we start cutting.
The fastest way is WhatsApp — tap the order or ask button on any page. Our team replies within the same day, every day of the week.
